heading.en: The Jaredites prepare for their journey to a promised land—It is a choice land whereon men must serve Christ or be swept off—The Lord talks to the brother of Jared for three hours—The Jaredites build barges—The Lord asks the brother of Jared to propose how the barges will be lighted.
heading.sm: Ua sauni sa Iareto mo la latou malaga i se laueleele na folafolaina—O lea laueleele o se laueleele filifilia e ao ina auauna atu ai ia Keriso e o nonofo ai a leai o le a tafiesea i latou—Ua fetalai mai le Alii i le uso o Iareto mo le tolu itula—Ua fausia e sa Iareto ni vaa—Ua fetalai le Alii i le uso o Iareto e fautua atu se ala e faamalamalama ai vaa.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Jared and his brother, and their families, and also the friends of Jared and his brother and their families, went down into the valley which was northward, (and the name of the valley was Nimrod, being called after the mighty hunter) with their flocks which they had gathered together, male and female, of every kind.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina o atu Iareto ma lona uso, ma o la’ua aiga, ma uo foi a Iareto ma lona uso, ma o latou aiga, i lalo i le vanu lea sa i le itu i matu, (ma o le igoa o le vanu o Nimarota, ua faaigoa i le tagata tulimanu malosi) faatasi ma a latou lafu manu ia sa latou faapotopoto faatasi, o manu po’a ma manu fafine, o ituaiga eseese uma.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And they did also lay snares and catch fowls of the air; and they did also prepare a vessel, in which they did carry with them the fish of the waters.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou tatao foi mailei ma seu manu felelei o le ea; ma sa latou saunia foi se faatanoa, na latou ave ai faatasi ma i latou i’a o vai.

verses.en: And they did also carry with them deseret, which, by interpretation, is a honey bee; and thus they did carry with them swarms of bees, and all manner of that which was upon the face of the land, seeds of every kind.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou ave foi faatasi ma i latou o tesareta, ia a faamatalaina, o le lago meli; ma sa faapea ona latou ave faatasi ma i latou faamoega o lagomeli, ma ituaiga o mea uma sa i ai i luga o le laueleele, o fatu o ituaiga taitasi uma.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when they had come down into the valley of Nimrod the Lord came down and talked with the brother of Jared; and he was in a cloud, and the brother of Jared saw him not.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua latou o ifo i le vanu o Nimarota sa afio ifo le Alii ma fetautalatalaai ma le uso o Iareto; ma sa i ai o ia i totonu o se ao, ma sa le vaai atu le uso o Iareto ia te ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lord commanded them that they should go forth into the wilderness, yea, into that quarter where there never had man been. And it came to pass that the Lord did go before them, and did talk with them as he stood in a cloud, and gave directions whither they should travel.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina poloaiina i latou e le Alii e tatau ona latou o atu i le vao, ioe, i le vaega lena e leai lava se tagata na oo i ai. Ma sa oo ina afio atu le Alii i o latou luma, ma fetalai mai ia te i latou ao tulai o ia i totonu o se ao, ma tuu mai faatonuga i le mea e tatau ona latou malaga i ai.

w.en: And it came to pass that
And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that they did travel in the wilderness, and did build barges, in which they did cross many waters, being directed continually by the hand of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou malaga i le vao, ma fauina ni vaa, ia na latou sopoia ai vai e tele, a o taitaiina pea e le aunoa e le aao o le Alii.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the Lord would not suffer that they should stop beyond the sea in the wilderness, but he would that they should come forth even unto the land of promise, which was choice above all other lands, which the Lord God had preserved for a righteous people.
verses.sm: Ma sa le tuuina atu i latou e le Alii e tuta mamao ese ma le sami i le vao, ae sa ia finagalo ia latou o mai seia oo mai lava i le laueleele o le folafolaga, sa sili a’e i lo isi laueleele uma lava, lea na faasaoina e le Alii le Atua mo tagata amiotonu.

verses.en: And he had sworn in his wrath unto the brother of Jared, that whoso should possess this land of promise, from that time henceforth and forever, should serve him, the true and only God, or they should be swept off when the fulness of his wrath should come upon them.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia tauto atu i le uso o Iareto i lona toasa, o soo se tasi na te mauaina lenei laueleele o le folafolaga, mai lena taimi ma le agai i luma ma le faavavau, e tatau ona auauna atu ia te ia, le Atua moni ma toatasi na’o ia, a leai o le a tafiesea i latou pe a oo mai le atoatoa o lona toasa i luga o i latou.

verses.en: And now, we can behold the decrees of God concerning this land, that it is a land of promise; and whatsoever nation shall possess it shall serve God, or they shall be swept off when the fulness of his wrath shall come upon them. And the fulness of his wrath cometh upon them when they are ripened in iniquity.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e mafai ona tatou vaaia fetalaiga faatulafonoina a le Atua e faatatau i lenei laueleele, e faapea o se laueleele o le folafolaga; ma o soo se atunuu latou te mauaina ia auauna atu i le Atua, a leai o le a tafiesea i latou pe a oo mai le atoatoa o lona toasa i luga o i latou. Ma e oo mai le atoatoa o lona toasa i luga o i latou pe a matua i latou i le amioletonu.

verses.en: For behold, this is a land which is choice above all other lands; wherefore he that doth possess it shall serve God or shall be swept off; for it is the everlasting decree of God. And it is not until the fulness of iniquity among the children of the land, that they are swept off.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, o se laueleele lenei ua silisili atu ona lelei i lo isi laueleele uma; o le mea lea o ia o le na te mauaina ia auauna atu i le Atua a leai o le a tafiesea o ia; ona o le fetalaiga faatulafonoina tumau e faavavau lea a le Atua. Ma o le a le tafiesea i latou seia oo ina oo mai le atoatoa o le amioletonu i fanau a le laueleele.

verses.en: And this cometh unto you, O ye Gentiles, that ye may know the decrees of God—that ye may repent, and not continue in your iniquities until the fulness come, that ye may not bring down the fulness of the wrath of God upon you as the inhabitants of the land have hitherto done.
verses.sm: Ma e oo mai lenei ia te outou, outou Nuuese e, ina ia outou iloa fetalaiga faatulafonoina a le Atua— ina ia outou salamo, ma aua tou te faaauau pea ia outou amioletonu seia oo mai le atoatoaga, ina ia outou le faatotō ifo le atoatoaga o le toasa o le Atua i o outou luga e pei foi ona sa faia e tagata sa aumau ai i le laueleele.

verses.en: Behold, this is a choice land, and whatsoever nation shall possess it shall be free from bondage, and from captivity, and from all other nations under heaven, if they will but serve the God of the land, who is Jesus Christ, who hath been manifested by the things which we have written.
verses.sm: Faauta, o se laueleele silisili ona lelei lenei, ma o soo se atunuu e mauaina o le a saoloto mai le pologa, ma mai le faatagataotaua, ma mai i isi atunuu uma e i lalo ifo o le lagi, pe afai latou te auauna i le Atua o le laueleele, o ia lea o Iesu Keriso, o le ua faaalia atu i mea ua matou tusia.

verses.en: And now I proceed with my record; for behold, it came to pass that the Lord did bring Jared and his brethren forth even to that great sea which divideth the lands. And as they came to the sea they pitched their tents; and they called the name of the place Moriancumer; and they dwelt in tents, and dwelt in tents upon the seashore for the space of four years.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei o le a ou faasolo atu i la’u talafaamaumau; aua faauta, sa oo ina aumai Iareto ma ona uso e le Alii seia oo atu lava i le sami tele lena ua vaeluaina le laueleele. Ma ina ua latou oo mai i le sami sa latou faatutū o latou faleie; ma sa latou faaigoaina le igoa o le nofoaga o Morianekumeri; ma sa latou nonofo i faleie, ma nonofo i faleie i luga o le matafaga mo le va o tausaga e fa.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of four years that the Lord came again unto the brother of Jared, and stood in a cloud and talked with him. And for the space of three hours did the Lord talk with the brother of Jared, and chastened him because he remembered not to call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le faaiuga o tausaga e fa, sa toe afio mai le Alii i le uso o Iareto, ma sa tu i totonu o se ao ma fetalai mai ia te ia. Ma mo le va o le tolu itula sa fetalai atu ai le Alii i le uso o Iareto, ma a’oa’i o ia ona sa ia le manatua e valaau atu i le suafa o le Alii.

verses.en: And the brother of Jared repented of the evil which he had done, and did call upon the name of the Lord for his brethren who were with him. And the Lord said unto him: I will forgive thee and thy brethren of their sins; but thou shalt not sin any more, for ye shall remember that my Spirit will not always strive with man; wherefore, if ye will sin until ye are fully ripe ye shall be cut off from the presence of the Lord. And these are my thoughts upon the land which I shall give you for your inheritance; for it shall be a land choice above all other lands.
verses.sm: Ma sa salamo le uso o Iareto i mea leaga na ia fai, ma ia valaau atu ai i le suafa o le Alii mo ona uso o e na faatasi ma ia. Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te ia: O le a ou faamagaloina oe ma ou uso i a latou agasala; ae aua e te toe agasala, aua ia outou manatua o lo’u Agaga e le finau pea ma le tagata; o le mea lea, afai o le a outou agasala seia oo ina outou matua atoatoa o le a vavae ese outou mai luma o le Alii. Ma o o’u manatu ia e uiga i le laueleele lea o le a ou tuu atu ia te outou e fai ma o outou tofi; ona o se laueleele o le a silisili ona lelei i lo isi laueleele uma.

verses.en: And the Lord said: Go to work and build, after the manner of barges which ye have hitherto built. And it came to pass that the brother of Jared did go to work, and also his brethren, and built barges after the manner which they had built, according to the instructions of the Lord. And they were small, and they were light upon the water, even like unto the lightness of a fowl upon the water.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii: Alu e galue ma fau ni vaa, e pei o vaa ia ua uma ona outou fausia. Ma sa oo ina alu atu le uso o Iareto e galue, ma ona uso foi, ma fausia vaa e pei o vaa ia ua uma ona latou fausia, e tusa ma faatonuga a le Alii. Ma sa laiti i latou, ma sa māmā i latou i luga o le vai, e pei lava o le māmā o se manulele i luga o le vai.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And they were built after a manner that they were exceedingly tight, even that they would hold water like unto a dish; and the bottom thereof was tight like unto a dish; and the sides thereof were tight like unto a dish; and the ends thereof were peaked; and the top thereof was tight like unto a dish; and the length thereof was the length of a tree; and the door thereof, when it was shut, was tight like unto a dish.
verses.sm: Ma sa fausia i latou i se ala sa matuā maopo lelei, e mafai ona to’a ai le suavai e pei lava o se ipu: ma o le liu sa maopo e pei o se ipu; ma o o latou itu sa maopo e pei o se ipu; ma o o latou taumua ma taumuli sa taufaasiusiu; ma o o latou fogavaa sa maopo e pei o se ipu; ma o lo latou uumi o le umi o se laau; ma o o latou faitotoa, pe a tapuni, sa maopo e pei o se ipu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the brother of Jared cried unto the Lord, saying: O Lord, I have performed the work which thou hast commanded me, and I have made the barges according as thou hast directed me.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tagi atu le uso o Iareto i le Alii, ua fai atu: Le Alii e, ua uma ona ou faia o le galuega na e poloaiina ai a’u, ma ua ou faia vaa e tusa e pei ona e faatonuina ai a’u.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And behold, O Lord, in them there is no light; whither shall we steer? And also we shall perish, for in them we cannot breathe, save it is the air which is in them; therefore we shall perish.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, le Alii e, ua leai se malamalama i totonu o i latou; o fea matou te uli atu i ai? Ma o le a matou fano foi, ona e le mafai ona matou manava i totonu o vaa, vagana le ea lea ua i totonu; o lea o le a matou fano ai.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto the brother of Jared: Behold, thou shalt make a hole in the top, and also in the bottom; and when thou shalt suffer for air thou shalt unstop the hole and receive air. And if it be so that the water come in upon thee, behold, ye shall stop the hole, that ye may not perish in the flood.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii i le uso o Iareto: Faauta, ia e faia se ava i luga o le fogavaa, ma lalo foi; ma a oo ina outou manaomia se ea ia outou tatala le ava ma maua ai le ea. Ma afai e faapea e sau le vai i o outou luga, faauta, ia outou tapuni le ava, ina ia outou le fano i le lolo.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the brother of Jared did so, according as the Lord had commanded.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faapea ona faia e le uso o Iareto, e pei ona poloaiina ai e le Alii.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And he cried again unto the Lord saying: O Lord, behold I have done even as thou hast commanded me; and I have prepared the vessels for my people, and behold there is no light in them. Behold, O Lord, wilt thou suffer that we shall cross this great water in darkness?
verses.sm: Ma sa toe tagi atu o ia i le Alii ua fai atu: Le Alii e, faauta ua uma ona ou faia e pei ona e poloaiina ai a’u; ma ua ou saunia vaa mo o’u tagata, faauta foi, ua leai se malamalama i totonu o vaa. Faauta, le Alii e, pe e te tuu ea i matou ia matou sopoia lenei vai tele i le pogisa?

verses.en: And the Lord said unto the brother of Jared: What will ye that I should do that ye may have light in your vessels? For behold, ye cannot have windows, for they will be dashed in pieces; neither shall ye take fire with you, for ye shall not go by the light of fire.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii i le uso o Iareto: O le a se mea tou mananao ia ou faia ina ia outou maua se malamalama i totonu o o outou vaa? Aua faauta, e le mafai ona outou faia ni faamalama, ona o le a ta’eia nutililii; pe tou te ave foi afi faatasi ma outou, ona tou te le o i le malamalama o le afi;

verses.en: For behold, ye shall be as a whale in the midst of the sea; for the mountain waves shall dash upon you. Nevertheless, I will bring you up again out of the depths of the sea; for the winds have gone forth out of my mouth, and also the rains and the floods have I sent forth.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, o le a pei outou o se tafola i totonu o le sami; ona o le a fafati galu faapei o mauga i luga o outou. Ae ui i lea, o le a ou toe ava’e outou mai le loloto o le sami; ona ua te’a atu matagi mai lo’u gutu, e faapea foi uaga ma lologa ua ou auina atu.

verses.en: And behold, I prepare you against these things; for ye cannot cross this great deep save I prepare you against the waves of the sea, and the winds which have gone forth, and the floods which shall come. Therefore what will ye that I should prepare for you that ye may have light when ye are swallowed up in the depths of the sea?
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua ou saunia outou e fetaiai ma nei mea; ona e le mafai ona outou sopoia lenei moana loloto vagana ai ua ou saunia outou e fetaiai ma galu o le sami, ma matagi ua te’a atu, ma lologa o le a oo mai. O lea o le a se mea tou te mananao ia ou saunia mo outou ina ia outou maua le malamalama pe a magoto ifo outou i le loloto o le sami?
